walkthrough: Goal: keep the replay as a video: an MP4 in the album to post or send, the whole drawing at the speed I chose, ending on the finished picture with a line of how many strokes and how long it took.
Before: the canvas of s163-replay (a closed shape and a wave, a fill, Layer 2 with two strokes); Actions › Replay…; it plays at 4x.

Entry: Export video… at the top right (ringed while its panel is open). The panel under it: Length as rows with their lengths: 30 s highlight (the whole fitted into thirty seconds, never slower than 1x), Full (the whole at the bar's speed), Segment (a part chosen on the track); Size: 1080p (the canvas fitted in 1920 x 1080, never enlarged) and 'Original 2880 × 1716' (the canvas's own size, greyed where the tablet's encoder cannot take it); End: Stop on the finished picture (three seconds held), Strokes and time (the line under it, offered with the first); Save to album in its pill and Share….

Choose and save: Full, then Save to album: the panel closes, the replay pauses, a pill in the top band reads 'Exporting video', a line filling and its percent, with Cancel; every other control is greyed and the system's back waits. The video is drawn frame by frame at 30 frames a second off the screen's work and encoded as H.264 into Movies/OpenPaint.

Success: the pill reads 'Video saved to album · 1 s' (its length) with Share… and OK. Share… opens the system's share sheet for that video; OK (or anything else) puts the pill away. The video plays in the gallery: blank paper, every stroke as drawn, the fill in its turn, Layer 2 over it, three seconds of the finished picture with the line '4 strokes · 2 layers · …' under it and OpenPaint quieter at its right.
Failure: an encoder that cannot start or a full disk: 'Couldn't export the video' with OK; nothing half-made is left in the album. Cancel: see s163-video-segment-zh.
Undo: making a video changes nothing in the artwork and is no step. Reopen: the video stays in the album; the replay and its choices start afresh.
